name: Cadastral
tagline: AI analyst for commercial real estate underwriting and diligence.
description: Cadastral is an AI-native, vertically specific platform for commercial real estate, billed as an 'AI analyst out of the box' that works without customer-specific training. It automates complex CRE workflows including T-12 analysis, lease abstraction, loan compliance, acquisitions due diligence, and end-to-end underwriting for real estate, private equity, and private credit teams.
insight: Founder Abe Somani previously built Leverton, an AI lease-abstraction company acquired by MRI Software in 2019.
edge: Ships as a CRE 'analyst out of the box' — works without per-customer model training, unlike platforms that need bespoke setup.
pros: Backed by JLL Spark, AvalonBay, Equity Residential

references.title: Cadastral: $9.5 Million Raised To Build 'AI Analyst In A Box'
